currentParagraphText: “I guess I should just go when the time comes... as you said, it’s not like I’ll lose anything by doing so, while I’ll at least get some free donations simply by showing up and witnessing the party. finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Now, as your friend... I don’t really care.
